fields.name: model
fields.help: Catalog or store id. Required.

fields.name: target
fields.help: Common extension. `local` runs here. `peer:<peer id or short label>` runs the whole request on that paired device (remote execution; the device decrypts and reads the prompt). Allowed only when privacy is `trusted_group`, networking is on and the device is pinned, not revoked and in a group allowing remote inference; otherwise 403 `policy_denied` / `peer_unauthorized` / `peer_revoked` before anything runs or connects. Every response echoes `target`.

fields.name: messages[].content
fields.type: string or null or array of object

fields.name: timings
fields.help: Common extension: engine timings.

fields.name: target
fields.help: Where it ran: `local` or `peer:<peer id>`.

fields.name: engine.last_exit
fields.help: The last engine that exited on its own (killed, crashed) since the daemon started; its slot was freed and the next request starts it again. Null when none has.

fields.name: context_note
fields.help: Set when the planner changed what was asked for: context capped to the trained context, reduced to fit memory, or the KV cache downgraded.

fields.name: listen_addr
fields.help: `ip:port` of the QUIC endpoint while enabled.

fields.name: peer_id
fields.help: This device's 64-hex id (its Ed25519 public key).

fields.name: device_name
fields.help: This host's name (the Computer Name on macOS, the hostname on other unix, COMPUTERNAME on Windows): the default name a paired device sees.

fields.name: dial_addr
fields.help: `ip:port` other devices should dial (the default-route address when the endpoint is bound on every interface); null while networking is off or when no route gives one.

fields.name: peer_quota
fields.help: `config.json` `peer_quota` in force (read at daemon start): per paired device, requests per minute and generated tokens per minute (0 = unlimited; a request's whole max_tokens is charged when it starts) and generations at once (also the cap across all devices, see `peer_slots`).

fields.name: peer_slots
fields.help: Peer generations this device runs at once across all devices: `peer_quota.max_concurrent`, at most the engine slots (`--max-concurrent`) minus one.

fields.name: peers[].health
fields.help: Liveness from keep-alives, updated within one keep-alive interval: `unhealthy` = still open but 3 intervals without a datagram; `reconnecting` = lost, a reconnect is expected; `disconnected` = closed on purpose, networking off, or never connected since networking started.

fields.name: peers[].last_error
fields.help: The latest failed dial to this device since its last connection (either direction); null when there is none or networking is off.

fields.name: peers[].held
fields.help: Disconnected by this device's user (`POST /api/peers/{id}/disconnect`) until Connect, turning networking off and on, or a service restart (a Sharing change keeps it); false while networking is off.

fields.name: peers[].capabilities
fields.help: null while not connected.

fields.name: peers[].connection
fields.help: The connection in use; null while not connected.

fields.name: discovered[].addr
fields.help: The best address, `addrs[0]`.

fields.name: discovered[].addrs
fields.type: array of string (at least 1, at most 2)
fields.help: IPv4 ip:port addresses from the signed record, best first (routable before loopback and link-local, lowest first).

fields.name: unreachable[].reason
fields.help: `link_local_only`: heard only at IPv6 link-local addresses; `other_family`: heard only at IPv6 addresses, some routable.

fields.name: revocations[].signature
fields.help: Ed25519 by `revoked_by`, hex.

fields.name: active
fields.help: Oldest first.

fields.name: active[].id
fields.help: The response id (`chatcmpl-…`, `cmpl-…`); `embd-…` for embeddings; the requesting device's `request_id` for `served_for_peer`.

fields.name: active[].client_ref
fields.help: `X-Common-Client-Ref` of the request.

fields.name: active[].target
fields.help: `local` or `peer:<hex>`: where it runs.

fields.name: active[].origin
fields.help: `local` or `peer:<hex>`: who asked.

fields.name: active[].state
fields.help: `queued` waiting for an engine slot, `connecting` a request to a paired device (no slot or load here) while this device reaches it, through the dial until the request is sent on the connection, `loading` in the model step, `running` generating (or sent to the device); `cancelled` when the requester went away or stopped it (`error_code` `cancelled` or `client_gone`). Daemons before `connecting` report that phase as `queued` with a `peer:` target; a client should read an unknown state as not known, never as an outcome.

fields.name: active[].completion_tokens
fields.help: Counted per streamed piece while active; the engine's count once done.

fields.name: active[].finish_reason
fields.help: From a paired device, at most 32 characters.

fields.name: active[].request_id
fields.help: Requests to or from a paired device; the `request_id` of both devices' `remote_request` audit entries.

fields.name: active[].device_actual
fields.help: Where the local engine runs it, e.g. `Metal0 (Apple M2)`; null for a request sent to a device (not reported).

fields.help: Newest first.
